reason: I already post my DJ nights on Instagram and I don't have time to manage another platform. An app nobody uses yet isn't going to fill my room, and students already find out about the nights through Instagram and word of mouth.
objection: I don't have time to manage another platform, and it isn't public yet, so I don't know if anyone will open it. Why would I pay €150 a month for an audience that doesn't exist?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app live with real users in my area, plus the free month where the founders load everything for me and I do nothing. Then I would try Stage if it clearly brings students through the door.
